title_as_printed: Experimental values of massic heat capacities c_p and calculated and literature (43) values of apparent molar heat capacities C_p,phi for NaCl(aq). Here c_p,s and c_p,w denotes the massic heat capacities of solution and water

footnotes_as_printed.a: deltaC_p,phi represents the estimated uncertainty as determined by the error propagation method.

pressure_note: flow calorimeter; p printed per row (0.1 to 30.6 MPa)

value.what: apparent molar heat capacity of NaCl from eq (8) Cp,phi = cp,w [(M + 1/m) cp,s/cp,w - 1/m]

value2.what: ratio of massic heat capacity of solution to that of water at T and p (measured, heat-loss corrected)

uncertainty.what: estimated uncertainty by error propagation (footnote a)

value3.what: Cp,phi from Archer's global NaCl(aq) fit (ref 43) at the same T, p, m

notes: Table printed over 9 pages with repeated headers (not written). Row 122 (573.39 K, 10.1 MPa) is printed with m = 0.4000 but its cp ratio, Cp,phi and literature value (-1077.42, the 0.2002 mol/kg literature value) belong with the two 0.2002 rows above it; the implied water cp of that row is inconsistent with m = 0.4000; likely a misprint of m; kept as printed. The last two rows (300, 301) are printed with T = 632.20 K; their implied water cp (6.375 J/(K g)) equals that of the 623.20 K / 30.2 MPa rows, so 632.20 is probably a misprint of 623.20; kept as printed. Row 68 (524.37 K, 0.0150 mol/kg) has deltaCp,phi printed 0.00 and Cp,phi -632.58, far from its replicates (-455 to -468); kept. At 623 K the literature column holds values (e.g. -10086.39) far from the measured ones; copied as printed.
